capabilities: scan the vault for unlinked mentions of note titles and aliases
insert wiki links into markdown files
cache scan results for faster repeat runs
filter which files get linked with include filters
debug notes that fail to parse with an interactive viewer
disambiguation: The name mentions a previewer, but the README only documents scanning and linking commands, not a preview.
extras: Requires well-formed Markdown: notes with escaping or termination errors fail to parse and are excluded from linking; a debugging parser viewer and developer documentation are referenced elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian only connects notes you link by hand, so mentions of other note titles scattered through the vault stay unlinked unless you find and convert them yourself.
summary: Automatic note linker that scans the vault for mentions of note titles and aliases and inserts wiki links, skipping code and math blocks.
